calibration_policy.validation: V23 and V24 remain evaluated on observed T0 with Tweedie D2 power 1.5
calibration_policy.interpretation_limit: Public comparison supports operational level; it does not identify private-target valuation or development pattern
calibration_policy.D70_original_method: Balance predictions on train 2021-2024 per line to T0 plus D67 estimated IBNR; retain explicit factor
calibration_policy.portfolio_level_assumption: S02 mean ultimate rate per line retained; composition-level changes neutralized, not empirically proved optimal
calibration_policy.D73_method_before_D76: Preserve S02 ultimate portfolio totals per line by normalizing model risk relativities; no second IBNR multiplication
